svg.title: WALTER design sheet
svg.text: 70s · rides it every night · three lines and a page turn · shape idea: the tall leaning wedge
THE QUIET CAR · character design · v1
Long coat widening to the hem,
#D9D3C3 folded to one page; black masthead
Gravity in stillness; a face that has finished
its grieving. Kind, never 'spooky old man'.
Heavy lids are his neutral: he looks half-asleep
and misses nothing. Eyes are pale grey-blue so
his looks (to the badge, to Noor) read in wides.
Hands are deliberately large and capable: the
wrist clamp must be fast and strong, and the
design should make that believable before it
Coat is good wool, looked after: someone who
still dresses properly for the train.
